resources.string: Add this device in Syncthing on your other device, then share a folder with the same folder ID. Both devices must accept the pairing. Only directly accessible local folders are supported.

Syncthing applies changes directly without a file preview and keeps conflict copies. Two-way sync propagates deletions in both directions. Send-only sends local changes and deletions; remote changes may prevent completion. Runs stop after 8 minutes and can resume. Both devices must be online during a run.
Keep 5 versions of files changed by the other device
